+"""String utility helpers."""
+import re
+from typing import Optional
+
+
+def slugify(text: str) -> str:
+    """Convert text to URL-safe slug."""
+    text = text.lower().strip()
+    text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]', '', text)
+    return re.sub(r'[-\s]+', '-', text)
+
+
+def truncate(text: str, max_length: int = 100, suffix: str = '...') -> str:
+    """Truncate text to max_length, adding suffix if truncated."""
+    if len(text) <= max_length:
+        return text
+    return text[:max_length - len(suffix)] + suffix
+
+
+def extract_domain(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Extract domain from URL string."""
+    match = re.match(r'https?://([^/]+)', url)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None
+
+
+def mask_email(email: str) -> str:
+    """Mask email address for display: john@example.com -> j***@example.com"""
+    local, domain = email.split('@')
+    return f"{local[0]}***@{domain}"
diff --git a/tests/test_string_helpers.py b/tests/test_string_helpers.py
new file mode 100644

+++ b/tests/test_string_helpers.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import pytest
+from app.utils.string_helpers import slugify, truncate, extract_domain, mask_email
+
+
+def test_slugify():
+    assert slugify('Hello World!') == 'hello-world'
+
+
+def test_truncate():
+    assert truncate('short') == 'short'
+    assert len(truncate('a' * 200)) <= 100
+
+
+def test_extract_domain():
+    assert extract_domain('https://example.com/path') == 'example.com'
+    assert extract_domain('invalid') is None
+
+
+def test_mask_email():
+    assert mask_email('john@example.com') == 'j***@example.com'
